cards.title: AUC Interpolation Methods
cards.claim: PKNCA supports three interpolation methods for AUC calculation between points: 'lin up/log down' (default, for exogenous substances with first-order elimination), 'linear' (for endogenous substances or non-first-order elimination), and 'lin-log' (linear before Tmax, log after). Zero-interpolation rules apply when both concentrations are zero.
limitations: Package defaults are not project approval
Other NCA tools may not describe interpolation as zero
Method choice affects calculated AUC values

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
